chunks: Verily this your order is one order, and I am your Lord; so worship Me.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the unity of the prophets' message and worship of God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tawhid* not merely as theological monotheism but as the basis for communal unity (*Ummah Wahidah*) under the guidance of the Prophet and the Imams. It highlights that true worship requires adherence to the singular divine authority, linking the spiritual oneness of God with the structural unity of the faithful community.
